note: Status -> action gate (Adriaan Mol, 30 Sep 2026). Every status cell in a requirements or evidence table (class statusgate on the page) is either complete (one of 'complete') or names an OPEN action here; tools/status_actions.py writes the link into the cell and --check fails the build on a non-complete status without an open action, and on an action closed while its status is still non-complete (unless the status text changed in the same commit). Rows are keyed by table and by the start of the requirement text.
